A support caster focused on performing rituals and strengthening the party's spells.

SKILLS

SPELLCASTING ASSISTANT · SL max 3

Whenever you support an ally's Magic Check through Teamwork, choose (SL) options:

  • Grant an additional +1 bonus to their Magic Check.
  • If the spell deals damage or restores HP, increase that number by 5.
  • Reduce the spell's total MP cost by 5, down to a minimum of 0.

You can pick the same option multiple times.

ACCELERATE RITUAL · SL max 3

Whenever you mark a segment of a ritual's Clock, you may spend up to (SL × 20) MP: Mark an additional segment for every 20 MP spent this way.

MAGICAL COUNTERMEASURES · SL max 3

When one or more creatures you can see or hear are threatened by a Spell with a total MP cost of (SL × 10) or lower, you may spend up to (SL × 10) MP to remove one creature from its list of targets for every 10 MP spent this way. If you use this Skill during a conflict, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.

RITUALISTIC EFFICIENCY · SL max 2

Gain a (+SL) bonus to any Ritual check you perform. Reduce the base cost of Rituals you initiate by (SL × 5) MP (down to a minimum of 1).

Whenever you make an Open Check related to your knowledge of magic, curses, rituals, spells, or other similar effects, add a bonus equal to (SL) on that Check.

LOYAL SUPPORTER · SL max 5

Whenever you are a supporting character in a Group Check (such as Teamwork), gain a (+SL) bonus to your roll. For every 3 points above the DL, grant the leader an additional +1 bonus.
